What's new in DuckOS 1.0.59

• Find My now reaches your phone right away, even with the screen off: Play Sound, Lost Mode, Locate and Erase. While Find My sharing is on, one quiet 'Find My is on' notification shows the phone is reachable.
• Lost Mode also turns on battery saver, so a lost phone stays findable for longer.
• Erase: you can factory-reset the phone from your account (confirmed with your DuckTask password on the website). This is a real wipe — only use it when you mean it.
